pages.text: $(thing)Requirement$(): Movement Path 15.$(br)$(thing)Type$(): active.$(br2)$(thing)Click$() the key while looking at a mob: it will be lifted into the air. Scroll the mouse wheel to move it closer. Release the key, and the mob will be thrown, dealing damage to it upon hitting a block.

$(thing)Hold$() lifts a block you are looking at. Scroll the mouse wheel to move it closer or further away. A subsequent press throws the block forward: hitting a mob will deal damage to it.$(br2)Blocks with internal storage (chests, furnaces) and those that are too hard (threshold in config $(thing)touchBlockMaxHardness$()) cannot be lifted.
